ideas.title: Medicaid Funding Dispute
ideas.description: Investigate the dispute between the Trump administration and Minnesota over Medicaid funding
questions: What are the implications of the Trump administration's withholding of Medicaid funds?
How will this affect healthcare services in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal a significant conflict between state and federal governments over healthcare funding. By following the money, we can uncover the motivations behind the Trump administration's actions and the impact on Minnesota's healthcare services.
